title: I've been playing RPG maker VX ace games and they keep randomly crashing.

posts.author: TheClownManGuy
posts.body: I've been playing RPGmaker VX ace games and they keep randomly crashing for whatever reason. There is always no error message, it just shuts down. It sometimes triggers when events or a fight triggers. This has happened to all RPGmaker VX ace games I played.

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body:
That usually means the RGSSx player on your PC is corrupted. To fix this if you are using Windows, you need to select to Restart Your PC. And I mean literally hit the restart PC button on the power options inside Windows, not just powering it off and on.
This is because Windows since Win8 does fast shutdown/restarts via saving of some stuff in memory when you select shutdown, and I have found if something like RGSSx player is corrupted it will save the corrupted version then reload it. This is fixed by restart which closes out then reopens everything, so it starts fresh(er).
If you are on Mac I have no suggestions though.
Also if on win11, you may be out of luck as I've heard win11 doesn't do well with the rgssx player ACE needs to run. You may have a little luck with compatibility mode though.

posts.author: oyajigari
posts.body:
Do you have BandiCam installed?
Games made with RPG MAKER VX Ace may crash if BandiCam is installed,
